disposition: The acknowledgement-level contract exists end to end: RegionalQuorum/GlobalQuorum/BackupAck with receipts naming every contributing Region and Member, a local commit receipt carrying no region or member facts, and typed success/timeout/error outcomes for the two-Region healthy-link, member-loss-before-acknowledgement, and region-loss-after-acknowledgement scenarios, served on the TBEP wire with BackupAck ordering (regional first, never rolled back). Deployed-Region qualification and production timeout defaults remain P7 and unresolved owner decisions.
